source: Mean geolocation_score of 2 reference-oracle runs through the engine (`ale validate` / `ale run --agent oracle`, engine 90a7c1c, RTX 4090, driver 570.211): 0.9254, 0.9379. full_at is the worst run's ratio to that mean, rounded down to 0.05.
note: geolocation_score is the mean mission score over the run, clamped at 0 once. A mission puts its targets 40-120 m from the start in different directions; it scores the mean of its per-target credit (a present target the drone went down and looked at, within 3 m horizontally, at most 6 m above it and in the down camera's view: located within 3 m earns 1, falling linearly to 0 at 10 m; one never visited earns 0 for its report; a decoy declared absent: 1; a present target declared absent: -1), times an energy factor (1 - 0.2 * min(1, path / budget), budget 1000 actions) and 0.5 after a collision when positive; aborted missions score 0. The reference is the token-privileged expert (oracle/): it flies to every placed object it is asked for, down into the visit window, holds there, reports it at its true position and every decoy as absent, steering by how far each move could go before touching anything (also given to it by the grader in privileged mode).
